bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears suffered more injury setbacks ahead of their Week 9 matchup with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, as left tackle Braxton Jones will undergo a season-ending procedure, leaving the Bears to weigh a trade for depth behind Theo Benedet , while running back Kyle Monangai has missed the last four games with toe and thumb injuries and Zavier Scott has now also joined the injured reserve list . Despite the banged-up roster, Chicago enters the week riding momentum after a big Monday night win, with the Bears completing a sweep of last season's Super Bowl teams and now facing a desperate NFC South team trying to claw its way into the division lead .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Linebacker Jack Campbell provided an encouraging update on his scary neck injury, revealing he now has full movement in his lower body while acknowledging ongoing challenges , as the Lions continue preparing for their Week 9 road matchup against the Dolphins. In roster moves related to the injury situation, Detroit is adding another linebacker to the practice squad following the Jack Campbell and Jimmy Rolder injuries , while the team also received positive injury report news with Amon-Ra St.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story heading into Week 9 is the Packers' injury situation and trade deadline buzz ahead of Sunday's matchup at New England, as star receiver Christian Watson was listed as a limited participant at Wednesday's practice after sustaining a rib injury in Green Bay's Week 8 win over the Panthers, though his participation in pads is a good sign for the Patriots game. Meanwhile, with the NFL trade deadline approaching on November 10, analyst Tom Silverstein suggested Green Bay could use edge rusher Lukas Van Ness as a trade asset to help facilitate a potential deal for Colts star running back Jonathan Taylor.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings announced that quarterback Kyler Murray will be sidelined for Monday Night Football against the Buffalo Bills with a hamstring strain, with Head Coach Kevin O'Connell confirming Carson Wentz will start in Murray's place while Max Brosmer serves as backup quarterback . The matchup carries extra weight as the Vikings (6-1) face off against the Bills (6-1) in a prime-time showdown , with Minnesota also reportedly exploring trade options like Jonathan Taylor ahead of the deadline to bolster their roster.
